limits: Dolphin evidence only; physical Wii cache and DMA behavior remain unverified.
The internal bridge cases are compatibility checks, not public ABI evidence.
AES checks use the fixed NIST AES-128 CBC known-answer vector. The async 64-byte case also changes only the staged tail and requires the callback ciphertext to change.
Boundary interception checks every logical input byte and the actual workspace allocation and release sizes.
The complete runtime probe assertion count is broader than formatter coverage. Use scenario and contract tables for formatter evidence.
